title: High-Volume, High-Value Customers (HAVING with AND)
description:
Find customers who have placed **more than 2 orders** AND whose **total spend exceeds $1,000**. Both conditions must be true.

**Table: orders** — `id`, `customer_id`, `amount`, `order_date`

Return `customer_id`, `order_count`, and `total_amount`. Order by `customer_id`.
solution_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 AND SUM(amount) > 1000 ORDER BY customer_id

test_cases.description: 2 customers qualify: customer 1 (3 orders, $1050) and customer 4 (3 orders, $2000)

hints: HAVING filters groups after aggregation — you can use COUNT() and SUM() directly in the HAVING clause.
Combine multiple HAVING conditions with AND, just like WHERE.
explanation: Per customer: cust 1 has 3 orders, sum=$1050 — both conditions met ✓. Cust 2 has 2 orders (fails COUNT > 2). Cust 3 has 3 orders but sum=$270 (fails SUM > 1000). Cust 4 has 3 orders, sum=$2000 — both met ✓. Cust 5 has only 1 order.
